source.note: One page per service. Tiers: two_layer (2-layer prototype), four_layer, six_layer (from the services index only; the six-layer page was not read), after_dark (black FR4, clear mask; 1 oz, same rules as two_layer). Blind and buried vias are not offered: 'We do not support blind or buried vias.'

min_annular_ring.note: One annular ring row for all plated holes.

pth_annular_ring.note: Same row as the via ring; the page gives one figure for every plated hole.

min_hole_to_hole.quote: 5 mil (0.127mm) clearance is recommended between holes.
min_hole_to_hole.note: A recommendation. Overlapping drills are 'Allowed, but not guaranteed.'

mask_expansion.unpublished: Not published. The page gives 'Maximum soldermask alignment | 3mil (0.0762mm)', which covers retraction, expansion and shift: a tolerance, not an expansion to design with.

min_silk_width.note: 3 mil is accepted for short lines, text and graphics: '3 mil (0.0762mm) (short lines, text, graphics)'.

copper_to_edge.quote: Board Edge Keepout | 15mil (0.381) from nominal board edge

surface_finishes.quote: PCB Finish | ENIG (Gold), compliant with IPC-4552
